summary: BranchOut Food Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Settlement Agreement and General Release with its former CFO, Doug Durst, and his affiliate Chase Innovations. The settlement resolves litigation arising from Durst's termination as CFO. The Company will pay $247,500 to Durst ($147,500 within 30 days, then $100,000 in five monthly installments of $20,000) and $55,890 to Chase. Additionally, BranchOut issued Durst a warrant to purchase 57,600 shares at $4.11 per share over a two-year term. This is a litigation settlement creating a financial obligation, not a special-situation event; watch for potential dilution from the warrant exercise.
